text: Screenshots of whiteboard apps (Miro, FigJam, Mural) usually show a light dotted or plain canvas: set page.background and a dots pattern rather than drawing dots as elements.
Mind-map branches leave the side of the parent that faces the child and enter the child's facing side; use curved connectors with bend around 0.5 and no arrowhead unless one is visible.
Repeated items (cards, sticky notes, bars) almost always share one exact size, colour set and font size; measure one carefully and reuse the numbers for the rest, aligning them on a common grid.
